a261009p1.summary: Anthropic is setting up a “presidential engagement” program ahead of the 2028 elections, building an in-house team …
a261009p1.title: Anthropic is setting up a "presidential engagement" program for the 2028 US elections that will offer AI policy education to candidates in both parties (Emily Forlini/Fortune)

a261009p10.summary: Meanwhile, a Sam Altman-backed company offering life insurance in bitcoin, raised $37.5 million in funding, CEO Zac Townsend tells Axios exclusively.
a261009p10.title: Meanwhile, a Sam Altman-backed bitcoin life insurance provider, raised $37.5M led by Bain Capital, sources say at a $350M valuation, up from $190M in April 2025 (Lucinda Shen/Axios)

a261009p11.summary: The Chinese developer of ARTEX said they have converted the AI agent to a closed-source project after cybersecurity firms identified …
a261009p11.title: The Chinese developer of ARTEX says it has converted the AI agent into a closed-source project after CrowdStrike said it was used to hack South Korean banks (Brenda Goh/Reuters)

a261009p12.summary: The UK is set to curb hiring restrictions that force employees to wait before moving jobs or starting companies …
a261009p12.title: The UK plans to curb non-compete rules that force employees to wait before moving jobs or starting companies, an issue that has drawn complaints from startups (Shona Ghosh/Bloomberg)

a261009p2.summary: Founder and chief executive Masayoshi Son has held talks with senior figures in the UAE in recent weeks
a261009p2.title: Sources: SoftBank is seeking to raise up to $100B from Gulf investors for a fund to buy companies and improve their operations with AI and other advanced tech (Financial Times)

a261009p3.summary: TAIPEI — Apple has told some of its suppliers to cut production of components for its newly launched iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max …
a261009p3.title: Sources: Apple told some suppliers to cut iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max component production by 15%-20% as higher memory costs pushed up prices and hurt demand (Nikkei Asia)

a261009p4.summary: Q3 delivered the widely expected PC downturn, with supply constraints, high price points, and logistical disruption eroding the usual seasonal lift
a261009p4.title: Global PC shipments dropped 20.1% YoY in Q3 to 62.7M units due to higher prices and supply issues; Lenovo dropped 22.6% YoY, HP 30.9%, Dell 25%, and Apple 11.3% (IDC)

a261009p5.summary: OpenAI on Friday defended its decision to fire three safety researchers, saying they had committed a “significant breach of trust.”
a261009p5.title: OpenAI says it didn't fire three researchers for "raising safety concerns or speaking out", but for violating "clear policies on handling sensitive information" (Michael Considine/CNBC)

a261009p6.summary: Facing pressure over weakened engagement and a depressed stock price, the streamer is prepping for a round of layoffs in the near future, per sources.
a261009p6.title: Sources: Netflix is preparing for layoffs that will impact ~5% of employees, or ~850 jobs, amid pressure over weakened engagement and a depressed stock price (Matthew Belloni/Puck)

a261009p7.summary: A cascade of cyberattacks has hit Japanese companies over the past few weeks, prompting the government to call for security checks …
a261009p7.title: A slew of cyberattacks hit Japanese companies in September, exposing the data of millions and prompting calls for security checks, as AI lowers hacking barriers (Sarah Hilton/Bloomberg)

a261009p8.summary: Commitment comes as GPUzilla prepares to fortify Uncle Sam's arsenal with at least seven AI-optimized supers
a261009p8.title: Nvidia commits $1B over five years to build out the US' "capacity for super intelligence R&D" in fields like quantum computing, healthcare, and energy security (Tobias Mann/The Register)

a261009p9.summary: Meta had delayed releasing Muse, its A.I. agent app, for months over safety concerns. Then new competition forced Mr. Zuckerberg's hand.
a261009p9.title: Sources detail Mark Zuckerberg's decision to launch Muse despite safety concerns, after seeing that AI startup Instinct's similar agent product gained traction (Eli Tan/New York Times)
